lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice coordinating study or work tasks by reporting constraints and negotiating a plan.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Adjusting a shared deadline or meeting time when several constraints collide.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Explaining constraints, responding to another need, and agreeing on a workable plan.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik coordinate a shared study or work task when one deadline, one appointment, and one preparation task overlap.

main_focus.name: constraint negotiation with medan and samtidigt
main_focus.description: Use medan and samtidigt to explain competing needs and negotiate a practical compromise.
model_examples: Jag kan skriva sammanfattningen medan du förbereder frågorna.
Samtidigt behöver vi lämna in allt före fredag.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 3-4 constraint/coordination sentences with medan or samtidigt.

allowed_supporting_grammar: future with ska and kommer att
polite disagreement with jag förstår, men

useful_chunks: Jag kan göra det medan du...
Kan vi dela upp ansvaret så här?
Då har vi en rimlig plan.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical coordination vocabulary without drifting into corporate register.

dialogue_shape.opening: A schedule conflict around a shared task is introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They explain constraints, divide responsibilities, and adjust the timing.
dialogue_shape.ending: They confirm a workable plan and what each part depends on.

target_complexity.repetition: constraint language should be recycled in realistic planning turns

focus: the coordination problem and competing constraints
the final plan and what it depends on

sentence_focus: one sentence saying two things conflict
one sentence confirming the workable plan
